strings.استلام البيت يصير أوضح لما تدخل الجولة و: Home handover is clearer when you arrive with an organised checklist rather than relying on memory or scattered photos. In lesson fifteen of the Almusaileem series, combine samples, decisions and operational test results in one defects log. The aim is to know each item’s status, who follows it up and how corrective work will be verified.

strings.جهّز نطاق العمل المعتمد، آخر التعديلات،: Prepare the approved scope of work, last edits, table of materials, samples, and photos of agreed details. Add the operating history from the previous lesson and any reports provided by the specialists. Make an appointment with the administrator that suits the readiness of the place, available lighting, and accessibility of the required parts. Do not record the covered or unavailable part as checked; write it as an item awaiting review.
strings.قسّم جولتك حسب الغرف، وداخل كل غرفة حسب: Divide your inspection by room and, within each room, by ceiling, walls, floor, doors and installed elements. This helps avoid missing small areas such as a dressing-room entrance or an edge behind a door. Keep visible-finish inspections separate from specialist technical tests, with a reference linking the two when a defect concerns both.
strings.صف الملاحظة بدون تخمين سببها: Describe the note without guessing why.
strings.بدل «صبغ الصالة مو مضبوط»، اكتب الموقع ب: Instead of “the hall paint is not right”, write down the exact location and what it reveals: a visible difference near the corner of the wall opposite the window, or the residue of a substance on the cabinet. Attach a general picture showing the place and a picture closer to the detail. Review the note with the contractor under the appropriate conditions and the agreed sample, and ask about the evaluation method adopted for the product or system if needed.
strings.لا تعتمد صورة بإضاءة شديدة أو زاوية غريب: Don’t rely on an image with intense lighting or a strange angle alone to judge, and don’t rule out a note because photography has shown it. No viewing conditions and discuss them on site.

strings.استخدم أوصافًا بسيطة: يحتاج تقييم مختص،: Use simple descriptions: it needs a competent evaluation, it needs to be processed, an incomplete document, or an item that has not been checked. If there is a leak effect, unstable part or safety mark, inform the competent official and do not test it yourself or cover it to improve the view. Address the cause and determine the readiness of the place from the appropriate authority before completing the associated finishing.
strings.بعض الملاحظات تكون اختلافًا عن عينة معتم: Some notes are different from an approved sample, and some are a new request from you after seeing the result. Record the difference clearly and review it with the administrator until the next step and its scope are determined. Do not assume that every cosmetic modification is an implementation note, and do not accept converting a clear matching note to a new request without reviewing the reference and the previous decision.
strings.أعطِ كل ملاحظة رقمًا ثابتًا، ثم سجّل الم: Give each note a fixed number, then record the administrator, the treatment plan and the agreed date. Once the performer informs you of its termination, see the place itself, the result of the treatment, and the adjacent surfaces. If they require specialist examination, verification goes to the owner. Keep a post-treatment image, and do not erase the first image; their presence shows the development of the condition.

Closing the record of observations here is a practical follow-up step, and does not require any professional accreditation.
